posts.title: Fix the autofocus on the Samsung GX10
posts.description: This procedure allows you to correct front-focus or back-focus problems using the camera's hidden debug menu. Tested on Samsung GX-10 firmware 1.30. 1. Create the debug file Create a plain-text file named MODSET.TXT containing exactly: [OPEN_DEBUG_MENU] Important: The file must use Windows-style CRLF line endings, including a final newline. Otherwise, the debug menu might not appear. Copy MODSET.T

posts.title: In the age of dishonest reviews, piracy is the consumer's last weapon
posts.description: The critics who were supposed to help us filter out the noise have become an integral part of the noise itself. Just like everyone can now make and publish a book, an album, a movie, a videogame, so can anyone become an influential figure capable of swaying consumer sentiments. Just when we needed them the most, critics became as diluted and appeasing as the art itself. I will not live to 1000 yea
